brief.analystNote: BTC at $60,151 is structurally inside Phase A accumulation ($53,448–$72,027) with the most important technical signal being the FAILED_AUCTION_LOW — price probed below $57,443 and was rejected, confirming responsive buyers defending the lower value area edge, with AMT rotation targets at $63,972 (POC) and $76,191 (VAH) over the medium term. However, the composite score of -2 reflects a genuine headwind stack: LTH holders are distributing at -15,710 BTC/day (7d avg, 0.374% of liquid supply), ETF flows turned negative at -$231M vs a +$264M/day baseline, stablecoin supply contracted $1.6B in 7 days, and macro conditions (10Y at 4.85%, VIX 26.4, gold surging in risk-off mode) are not supportive of imminent price acceleration. The CME basis at +38.79% annualized (near expiry, so monitor the January roll) and MVRV 1.125 at fair value anchor the fundamental case that this is not a sell zone — it is a measured accumulation window for a 1-2 year mandate, but sizing should remain conservative (25-33% of DCA reserve) until ETF flows turn consistently positive and LTH distribution moderates below -5,000 BTC/day on the 7d average. Thanksgiving US holiday today reduces market liquidity — prefer limit orders and expect wider spreads. Note: market regime flagged 'insufficient history (57 cycles)' — phase anchors are directionally sound but statistically provisional, adding one layer of caution to mechanical triggers.
